items.title: Scott Wiener claims Pelosi’s San Francisco seat in US midterms after all-Democratic race
items.summary: Former California Jewish Caucus co-chair set to become city’s first openly gay congressman; he and opponent Connie Chan both accused Israel of genocide during the campaign

items.title: Police clash with protesters in France’s Lyon amid fresh unrest
items.summary: Trade unions organize marches calling for wage raises, tax reforms, claim 250,000 taking part; school set alight near Toulouse; iconic Eiffel Tower closed; 70,000 police deployed

items.title: El Al reaps record quarterly revenue amid peak summer travel and scarce competition
items.summary: Flag carrier leverages dominant position, with planes 95% full, amassing a record $1.1 billion booking backlog as foreign airlines have yet to fully return to Tel Aviv

items.title: Report warns of growing threat of deadly attacks on synagogues worldwide
items.summary: Attackers increasingly use lethal weapons and target congregants on way to services, Diaspora Affairs Ministry says ahead of the anniversary of Kristallnacht
